parameters.name: DatabaseId
parameters.description: The ID of the physical database. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) or [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~) operation to obtain the ID of the physical database.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: ReturnGuid
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the GUID of a table. Valid values:

*   **true**: returns the GUID of a table.
*   **false**: does not return the GUID of a table.

parameters.name: SearchName
parameters.description: The name used to search for tables. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to query the tenant ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise list-tables --tid 3000 --database-id 18600000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --search-name test --return-guid true --real-login-user-uid 1234 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise ListTables --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SearchName test --ReturnGuid true --RealLoginUserUid 1234 --DatabaseId 18600000 --Tid 3000
